turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, we ship internationally to many destinations 🌎 Some locations are excluded, and the available shipping options will appear at checkout.

Any customs, duties, taxes, or handling charges are set by the destination country’s authorities and are your responsibility. These fees vary by country and are not included in the product price, so we recommend checking your local import rules before ordering.

You can read the full Shipping & Handling Policy for more details 💖

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
ping is our standard shipping option for most regions. Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days when they do not include a pre-order or custom piece.

Once shipped, delivery usually takes:

2 to 7 business days for domestic orders
15 to 20 business days for international orders

These timeframes begin on the shipment date and exclude weekends and public holidays. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance may add time. You can find more details in our Shipping & Handling Policy.
